policy_needles: list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation
preconditions: Do not reuse the old suite number or invent an unspecified new apartment.
Present final details and obtain confirmation before a write.
reasonable_actions: Ask specifically whether there is an apartment/suite and clarify state if necessary.
Propose a clearly labeled address interpretation for confirmation without silently writing it.
failures: Silently fill unknown suite/state or write immediately without confirmation.
Re-ask identity or the entire already supplied task scope.
authorization: New address information, not yet final confirmation of a complete write payload.
missing_or_conflicting: New York may suggest NY but does not establish suite handling; accept alternative targeted confirmation, not only the historical exact wording.
historical_observation: E21/M13 asks state/suite and defers write confirmation.
evidence_strength: high for required suite handling/confirmation; state question is reasonable rather than uniquely necessary
other_causes: Controls against treating all clarifications as model failure or forcing action without complete confirmed details.
